# Adventure Safari Africa

> Private, tailor-made African safaris across Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda,
> Botswana, Namibia, South Africa and Ethiopia. One specialist designs the
> trip, one expert local guide drives it.

The company is an African safari operator, not a booking marketplace. Prices
are quoted per person for two travellers in USD, split into green season and
peak season. Itineraries are private and adjustable.

## Key pages

- [Safari packages](https://www.adventuresafariafrica.com/africa-safari-packages/): every package with duration, price and route.
- [Destinations](https://www.adventuresafariafrica.com/africa-safaris/): country-by-country safari guide.
- [National parks](https://www.adventuresafariafrica.com/national-parks/): park index with the wildlife each is known for.
- [Travel guide](https://www.adventuresafariafrica.com/travel-guide/): practical planning, costs, timing and safety.
- [Accommodation](https://www.adventuresafariafrica.com/accommodation/): where to stay by country.
- [Activities](https://www.adventuresafariafrica.com/activities/): gorilla trekking, Kilimanjaro, balloon safaris.
- [About](https://www.adventuresafariafrica.com/about/): who runs the company and how trips are planned.
- [Request a proposal](https://www.adventuresafariafrica.com/request-proposal/): the contact route for a tailored quote.
